Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the specific "place of death" from the search results. In Step 4, the search results explicitly stated in the auto-generated snippet and visible text: "William Adam, the Scottish architect, died in Edinburgh, Scotland." The agent ignored this direct confirmation and continued to claim that the place of death was not confirmed, relying instead on the burial location (Greyfriars Kirkyard) as a proxy. This failure to recognize the explicit statement in the retrieved data prevented the task from being completed successfully.
